Based on my analysis of the code, here are the files that implement JSON serialization for nested timestamps, enumerations, decimal numbers, and unique identifiers:

`fastapi/encoders.py`
This is the core implementation. It contains the ENCODERS_BY_TYPE dictionary mapping special types (datetime.date, datetime.datetime, datetime.time, Decimal, Enum, UUID, etc.) to their encoder functions, plus the recursive jsonable_encoder function that traverses nested structures.

`fastapi/routing.py`
Uses jsonable_encoder to serialize response content when returning data without an explicit Pydantic response model, and in streaming contexts.

`fastapi/_compat/v2.py`
Provides Pydantic v2 integration for model serialization, including the ModelField class that delegates to Pydantic's model_dump and model_dump_json methods for handling the conversion of nested complex types.

`fastapi/exception_handlers.py`
Uses jsonable_encoder to serialize validation errors and other exception data for JSON responses.
